title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Multisectoral Emergency Response & Resilience Building of IDP and Host Communities in Gogrial East and Tonj North Counties, Warrap State programme implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include, Participatory Capacity and Vulnerability Analysis (PCVA) conducted, DRR committees formed, and community development plans drafted. So, Communities adopt measures and approaches which strengthen their resilience to cope with crises and shocks. Programmes are in partnership with Hope Agency for Relief and Development (HARD) ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- Increase the resilience of poor and marginalised rural communities by mitigating and adapting to the impacts of climate change and environmental degradation.- Strengthen climate disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crisis and also to protect what they have - Disaster Risk Management reduces the vulnerability of households and communities to the impacts of climate change, supporting them to adapt to a changing climate and the associated hazards e.g. increased flooding, drought and cyclones etc. Preparedness involves measures to reduce the impacts of these hazards, further contributing to climate adaptation
